---
title: "About This Portfolio"
description: "The purpose, scope, and privacy choices behind this technical portfolio."
---

Explain the technologies you are learning and the kinds of problems you want to solve. Keep the focus on your work, skills, evidence, and goals. Do not add information that identifies your timetable, location, or private accounts.

## How the work is checked

Each project separates predictions from observations, gives units, identifies limitations, and records at least one independent verification.

## Attribution

Identify sources, licences, collaborators, and adapted materials beside the work that uses them. Follow your teacher's required citation format.
